description_en: Gets a Security Token Service (STS) token
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center get-sts-token --biz-external-id Alex --end-user-id Alex --expiration 600 --api-version 2021-02-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetStsToken

parameters.help_en: The ID of the external user
parameters.name: external_id

parameters.help_en:
The Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) username.

Either EndUserId or ExternalId is required
parameters.help_zh:
无影用户名。


无影用户名与外部ID必填其一
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the token, in seconds. The maximum period is two days
parameters.help_zh: 过期时间，单位为秒，最长支持2天
parameters.name: expiration
